caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a round brass or gold-colored tray at the base, with a raised circular section in the middle. Rising from the center of the tray is a small statuette of a figure, possibly a man, which is fashioned in a dynamic stance with one hand on its hip and the other arm raised to support a round vertical medallion or mirror. The statuette and surrounding tray are rendered in shades of gold, bronze, and brown. The circular medallion at the top is bordered in gold and filled with a solid deep blue or indigo color, and is topped with an ornate gold flourish, possibly in a leaf or feather design. The artist’s signature “W.O. Fletcher” is visible in the bottom right-hand corner of the drawing.
title: Pickaninny Watch Stand
